name: fix86_npc_block
verifies: fix-86: the hero does not walk through characters (G3: every character is a physics character controller; the touch callback OnCharacterTouchesCharacter does nothing, so nobody is shoved and nobody complains). Ardea at the start: Hamlar standing (frozen) and pacing (his Pace routine), Gorn sitting at the campfire, Gorn as a party member following, a wolf standing; a dead wolf is walked over. Each bump stops the hero at contact distance (hero radius + body footprint).
steps: log -- Hamlar pacing (walking routine): he may walk into the hero, the hero never walks into him
log -- Gorn sitting at the campfire (from behind)
log -- Gorn as a party member (follows the hero)
log -- a creature: a wolf standing, then dead (walked over)
spawn Wolf attitude=neutral dist=4 side=front as=w1
notes: bump = the hero runs at the NPC's current position every frame (ScenarioRunner.Fix86); blockedby = the actor whose body clipped the hero's last blocked move (G3Player.LastBlockingBody); bodyblocks = clipped moves since start. Contact = CharacterController radius (0.29 since fix-148, G3.Player.HeroCapsule; 0.35 before) + CombatBody.Footprint (human ~0.3-0.4 m). fix-105 (r40 wolf 'closest 0.90 m, contact 1.06 m'): a blocked bump measures to the body's capsule centre, round which the hero is stopped; a wolf's lies 0.16 m behind its root (the old root distance came out 1.06 - 0.16). The pacing bump allows 0.35 m less: Hamlar walking into a standing hero: since fix-93 the NPC side goes round him / stops at contact (NPCEvadeSwitch, scenario fix93_npc_evade); the tolerance stays.
